title: Service request procedure for initiating an emergency PDU session not accepted by the network

entities.name: Service request procedure for initiating an emergency PDU session
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to establish an emergency PDU session when the network does not accept the service request.

entities.name: Procedures from subclause 5.6.1.5
entities.description: Procedures performed by UE when service request for emergency PDU session is not accepted by network.

entities.name: Procedures from subclause 5.6.1.7
entities.description: Procedures performed by UE when service request fails due to abnormal cases.

entities.name: UE in same selected PLMN where last service request was attempted
entities.description: Condition where UE remains in the same PLMN where the previous service request was made.

entities.name: Inform upper layers of procedure failure
entities.description: UE informs upper layers about the failure of the service request procedure for emergency PDU session.

entities.name: De-register locally
entities.description: UE performs local de-registration if not already de-registered.

entities.name: Initial registration for emergency services
entities.description: UE attempts initial registration specifically for emergency services after local de-registration.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure for emergency PDU session.

relations.description: Service request procedure includes performing procedures from subclause 5.6.1.5 when not accepted by network.
Service request procedure includes performing procedures from subclause 5.6.1.7 when failing due to abnormal cases.
Service request procedure requires UE to be in same PLMN condition for subsequent actions.
When UE is in same PLMN condition, it establishes the action of informing upper layers of procedure failure.
When UE is in same PLMN condition, it establishes the action of local de-registration.
After local de-registration, UE performs initial registration for emergency services.
Service request procedure involves sending SERVICE REQUEST message.
